verdict.rationale: The docs show a broad REST API (and 5 SDKs) covering nexus, registrations, filings, exemptions, transaction sync, credit notes, product categorization, and tax estimation, suggesting the API is the primary interface, and an MCP server further aids AI-native workflows by exposing docs/OpenAPI to assistants. However, there is no explicit statement confirming full UI/API parity or listing any UI-only features (e.g., dashboard analytics, connector setup UI) not exposed via API. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing every UI action has an API equivalent, and confirmation that connector/dashboard-only features are also API-accessible.
